raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Plant-Protein Muscle Gain Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "muscle hypertrophy and strength gain on plant-protein plan"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Hypertrophy Foundation A":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Hypertrophy Foundation B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Hypertrophy Foundation C":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progressive Overload A":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Progressive Overload B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x5..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Progressive Overload C":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          upright_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase 3 A":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Phase 3 B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x4..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Phase 3 C":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          demi_seed 0
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Peak Hypertrophy A":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Peak Hypertrophy B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x4..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hamstring_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 4x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 60m "Peak Hypertrophy C":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: 3x8..12.
- Sets always come first: 3x10 means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: 3x8..12 rpe 7.
- Rest in seconds: rest 90 seconds.
